stories.story_fr: Le chiffre d'affaires a augmenté de 3,8 % en glissement annuel pour atteindre 78,4 milliards de dollars au deuxième trimestre 2026.
stories.story_en: Revenue increased 3.8% year-over-year to $78.4 billion in Q2 2026.
stories.quote: revenue increased 3.8 percent year-over-year to $78.4 billion

stories.story_fr: Le guide d'EPS ajusté a été relevé à une fourchette de 17,65 $ à 17,90 $ pour l'exercice 2026.
stories.story_en: Adjusted diluted EPS guidance was raised to $17.65‑$17.90 for fiscal 2026.
stories.quote: Adjusted diluted EPS guidance has been raised from the previous range of $17.45 to $17.75 to a range of $17.65 to $17.90

stories.story_fr: Cencora prévoit de racheter 1 milliard de dollars d'actions d'ici la fin de l'année civile 2026.
stories.story_en: Cencora expects to repurchase $1 billion in shares by the end of calendar 2026.
stories.quote: Cencora ... expects to repurchase $1 Billion in Shares by the End of Calendar 2026

stories.story_fr: Le BPA GAAP a bond à 8,40 $ au deuxième trimestre 2026, contre 3,68 $ l'année précédente.
stories.story_en: GAAP diluted EPS rose to $8.40 in Q2 2026 from $3.68 a year earlier.
stories.quote: diluted earnings per share (EPS) was $8.40 for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 compared to $3.68 in the prior year second quarter
